claims.evidence: Seller's text; HP logo visible in photos 0 and 2.
Screen size not visible in any photo; no label or measurement shown. Seller's text only.
Intel Core i5 sticker visible on palm rest in photos 0 and 2.
No system information visible in photos. RAM cannot be confirmed from stickers or screen. Seller's text only.
No storage information visible in photos. Cannot confirm from stickers or screen. Seller's text only.

risks.risk: RAM is not 8GB or is faulty
risks.proof: Photo of Task Manager or System Information showing 8GB RAM.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having less than 8GB or not working

risks.risk: Storage is not 256GB SSD or is failing
risks.proof: Photo of Disk Management or System Information showing 256GB SSD.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having smaller or HDD storage

risks.risk: Laptop has physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., hinge wear, screen dead pixels, keyboard issues)
risks.proof: Close-up video or photos of hinges, screen edges, and keyboard under different lighting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential cosmetic or functional defects

risks.risk: Battery health is poor or not original
risks.proof: Photo of battery health report from Windows or BIOS.

proof_requests: Photo of System Information or Task Manager showing 8GB RAM and 256GB SSD.
Close-up video of keyboard, hinges, and screen edges under different lighting.
Photo of the bottom of the laptop showing model number or serial.
response.reason: The model and brand are supported, but critical specs like RAM and SSD cannot be verified from photos alone. Physical condition risks also require further proof. Without confirmation of specs and condition, a worst-case price cannot be reliably assigned.
